analysis.summary: During the financial year 2025-26, GNA Axles experienced a 4% decline in net operating revenue due to tariff-induced export headwinds in the US market, though this was partially offset by robust domestic demand from the tractor and commercial vehicle segments. Management focused on operational efficiency, cost control, and capacity utilization, resulting in improved profitability with PAT increasing to 116.99 crores. The company is strategically expanding into Light Vehicles, Passenger Vehicles, and SUVs, and established GNA Mobility Limited to diversify its product portfolio and capture new growth opportunities. GNA Axles Limited reported net revenue of ` 1,539.74 Cr and an EBITDA of ` 210.61 Cr for the financial year 2024-25, alongside the incorporation of a new wholly-owned subsidiary, GNA Mobility Limited, in February 2025. Management highlighted steady performance driven by export growth and niche product leadership, while noting external risks such as potential trade tariffs in key overseas markets like North America.

guidance.claim: Domestic tractor sales are expected to post a lower single-digit growth in the year.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for commercial vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: The company remains cautiously optimistic about domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while keeping a close watch on geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices and inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW.
capex_expansion.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

capex_expansion.claim: The company installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that optimizing capacity utilisation and maintaining strict cost control enhances efficiency and operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: Our emphasis on optimising capacity utilisation and maintaining strict cost control continues to enhance efficiency and strengthen operating leverage.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for the year stood at 13.68%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported selling 3,882,041 rear axle shafts, 1,105,733 spindles, and 327,019 other shafts during 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of ` 3 per equity share for 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its solar capacity further in 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
